trials.claim: Tier 1 allows up to 10 websites and Tier 2 up to 100 websites
trials.claimQuote: Tier 1 includes activation for up to 10 websites, while Tier 2 includes activation for up to 100 websites.
trials.reasoning: E1 only shows the vendor's regular Professional and Agency plan limits, which are not evidence against a deal-specific tier promise. No exhibit shown confirms the deal's Tier 1 and Tier 2 website limits.

exhibits.quote: Our Professional plan allows usage on up to 5 websites, while our Agency plan supports up to 100 websites under a single license.
exhibits.argument: Vendor's own plan limits Professional to 5 websites, not 10 as claimed for Tier 1.

trials.claim: Includes all future Plus Plan or Growth Plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Plus Plan (Code 1) or Growth Plan (Code 2) updates
trials.reasoning: The binding terms in E2 reserve the right to change packages, features, and other things, materially limiting a promise of all future Plus or Growth Plan updates. The defense exhibits only mention regular or frequent updates generally, not that specific future-plan guarantee.

exhibits.quote: We have the right to change the policy, terms & Conditions, packages, price, features, or any other things on this website.
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves right to change features and packages, undermining promise of all future updates.

exhibits.quote: Premium also includes priority support and regular updates.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states premium includes regular updates, supporting future updates.

exhibits.quote: Fast and efficient support team. Frequent updates. One of my better acquisitions on appsumo.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms receiving frequent updates as promised.

trials.claim: Drag-and-drop page builder works for both Elementor and Gutenberg
trials.claimQuote: Transform default WooCommerce pages with a drag-and-drop page builder for Elementor and Gutenberg
trials.reasoning: E9 states ShopLentor is a WooCommerce page builder for Elementor and Gutenberg, and E10 confirms a drag-and-drop interface. E3 complains only about customizing the add-to-cart button and does not contradict the builder working for both editors.

exhibits.quote: But for now, it's impossible to really customize "add to cart" button, such a shame, hope this feature will be improve very soon.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports core builder customization is impossible, undermining drag-and-drop builder claim.

exhibits.quote: ShopLentor is the all-in-one WooCommerce page builder for Elementor & Gutenberg.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms page builder works for both Elementor and Gutenberg.

exhibits.quote: Experience a user-friendly drag-and-drop interface designed to help you achieve professional results.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms the interface is drag-and-drop.

trials.claim: Design shop, product, cart and checkout pages without coding
trials.claimQuote: ShopLentor lets you design shop, product, cart, and checkout pages in Elementor or Gutenberg—no coding required.
trials.reasoning: E11 confirms customizing the store without touching code, and E12 confirms page-builder functionality for products, cart, checkout, and account pages. E4 is a refund reason about user skill and does not show coding is required.

exhibits.quote: You don’t have enough skills to use the item.
exhibits.argument: Vendor denies refunds for lack of skills, showing skill is required despite no-coding claim.

exhibits.quote: Customize every part of your WooCommerce store without touching a single line of code.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms full store customization without coding.

exhibits.quote: Love the design and functionality of the product because it offers the same functionality of a page builder for my products, cart, checkout, and my account pages.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms page builder covers product, cart and checkout pages.

trials.claim: Rebuild shop, cart, checkout and account pages in Elementor or Gutenberg
trials.claimQuote: Rebuild your shop, cart, checkout, and account pages in Elementor or Gutenberg so your store stops looking like a default install
trials.reasoning: E13 confirms page-builder functionality for products, cart, checkout, and account pages, and E14 confirms creating custom templates to replace default WooCommerce pages. E5 wishes for a Product Loop for archives and categories, which does not contradict those listed pages.

exhibits.quote: I'd also wish a Product Loop would be included so we can create and customise our own archives, categories and related product cards.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports missing Product Loop prevents creating custom archives and categories as claimed.

exhibits.quote: Love the design and functionality of the product because it offers the same functionality of a page builder for my products, cart, checkout, and my account pages.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms builder covers shop, cart, checkout and account pages.

exhibits.quote: Change the boring design of the default WooCommerce pages and bring a brand new look to your store by creating custom templates using the powerful widgets of ShopLentor.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms rebuilding default WooCommerce pages with custom templates.

trials.claim: Store does not have to look like default WooCommerce stores
trials.claimQuote: Your WooCommerce store doesn’t have to look like every other WooCommerce store.
trials.reasoning: E15 promises replacing boring default WooCommerce designs with a brand new look, and E16 says the tool helps an ecommerce store stand out. E6 says premade blocks are similar within categories, but does not show stores must look default.

exhibits.quote: Also, premade blocks are quite all similar in each category. More style diversity would be great time saver.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports premade blocks all look similar, undermining claim store won't look generic.

exhibits.quote: Change the boring design of the default WooCommerce pages and bring a brand new look to your store by creating custom templates using the powerful widgets of ShopLentor.
exhibits.argument: Vendor promises replacing boring default design with a brand new look.

exhibits.quote: The functionality that elementor has around woocommerce it´s not very good and woolentor gives you that extra plugins/widgets that you need to make your ecommerce store stand out.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms store stands out instead of looking default.
